P2P WebRTC (PeerJS) baby monitor, Vite/TypeScript: Baby streams; Parent receives. `src/main.ts` routing/URL (`station`, `roomId`); `src/baby-station.ts` camera/mic, QR, settings; `src/parent-station.ts` playback, meters, alerts, reconnection; `src/motion-detection.ts` frame differencing; `src/utils.ts` media/wake lock; `src/dictionary.ts` room IDs; `src/style.css` dark theme. Build/deploy: `vite.config.ts`, `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`. Colocated `*.test.ts` use Vitest globals; `tests/` holds Playwright.

Each station has `init*` returning `CleanupHandle`.
All stations MUST return `{ cleanup: () => void }` for proper teardown
Use `querySelectorOrThrow()` - never silently fail on missing DOM
Always request on station init, release in cleanup
Never leave MediaStream tracks running after cleanup
Never use `querySelector` without null check (use `querySelectorOrThrow`)
Don't hardcode PeerJS peer IDs in parent station (random ID, call by room)
No separate vitest.config - test config embedded in `vite.config.ts`
Always use `bun test -- --run` to disable watch mode (prevents agent bash timeout)

Room IDs: `WordWordWord1234`. UI: `.settings-drawer`, `.toast`, `.video-alert`; CSS variables in `:root`. Parent retries 5s+ apart; Baby prefers `facingMode: environment`; audio RMS `level * 3`; motion: 160x120, 2-second cooldown. Vitest runs `src/*.test.ts` only; Playwright `tests/` excluded via `vite.config.ts`. Bun scripts:

bun run dev
bun run dev:https
bun run build
bun run test -- --run
bun run preview
bun run dev:https -- --host <REDACTED_IP>
